s124.primary: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקֹנֵה הַכֹּל וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה. מִסּוֹד חֲכָמִים וּנְבוֹנִים. וּמִלֶּמֶד דַּעַת מְבִינִים. אֶפְתְּחָה פִי בִּתְפִלָּה וּבְתַחֲנוּנִים. לְחַלּוֹת וּלְחַנֵּן פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים וַאֲדוֹנֵי הָאֲדוֹנִים אֶת חִיל יוֹם פְּקוּדָה. בְּאֵימוֹ כָּל לֶחֶם לְשָׁקְדָה. גִּשְׁתָּם בְּבֶרֶךְ קְדוּדָה. דַּעַם לְטַהֵר כְּעַל מוֹקְדָה: הַיּוֹצֵר יַחַד כָּל נִשְׁפָּט. וְשׁוֹעַ וְדַל בְּפֶלֶס נִשְׁפָּט. זָכַר לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט. חִנּוּי עֶתֶר יוּצַג בְּמִשְׁפָּט: טֶרֶם כָּל מִפְעָל חָצַב. יוֹם מֵאֶמֶשׁ צוּר הֻצַּב. בְּאֵחוּד וְקוֹדֶם כְּתוֹךְ

s125.primary: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac and God of Jacob, great, mighty and awe-inspiring God, God the Most High, who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children’s children for His Name’s sake in love. Choosing from the counsel of wise and discerning men and from the teaching of those that understand knowledge, I open my mouth in prayer and supplication to entreat and implore the countenance of the King of Kings and the Lord of Lords. The fearful day of reckoning has arrived. All flesh is full of dread of reprimand. They approach to bend the knee before Him, to purify their thoughts as in the flame of the altar. He who has formed the heart of all of them together, judges so that rich and poor alike are judged according to the scales. He remembers him who said: ‘Will He not do justice?’ His valued prayer will be recalled in judgment. Before He formed any creature, he had planned that rock from which we were hewn (Abraham). s126.primary: נֶחְצַב. לְהָב עֶלְיוֹן כָּל הַמַּחְצָב: מֵאַרְחוֹ כְּהַיּוֹם כֹּחַ הֻשָּׁה. נֶצֶר לְהַחֲנִיט לְתִשְׁעִים שָׁה. סִימָה אוֹת הֱיוֹת לְשׁוֹשַׁנָּה. עֲבוֹר לְפָנָיו בְּזֶה רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה: פָּלְצוּ פְרָחֶיהָ בְּזֶה יוֹם. צַנְחָם פְּנֵי כֵּס אָיוֹם. קוֹל רִנּוּנָם יִרְחֲשׁוּ כַהַיּוֹם. רוֹגְשִׁים לְהָרִיעַ לִמְצוֹא פִדְיוֹם: שְׁעוּנִים עָלֶיהָ בָּהּ לְהִפָּקְדָה. שׁוֹאֲנִים בְּדָפְקָם דְּלָתוֹת לְשָׁקְדָה. תְּמוּכִים בְּדֶשֶׁן שֶׂה עֲקֵדָה. תֶּשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נִפְקְדָה: נַעֲלָה בְדִין עָלוֹת בִּתְרוּעָה. גֵּא עִם דָּרֶיהָ לְרוֹעֲעָה. בְּשׁוֹפָר אֲפַתֶּנּוּ. וּבְבֶרֶךְ כְּרָעָה. בִּמְגִנַּת רֵעִים בְּגַנּוֹ אֲתְרוֹעֲעָה: זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים. וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים. לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:

s127.primary: was he hewn, on him the whole structure is founded. His allotted wife was on this day granted vigour to bring forth a shoot at ninety years. She was set as an example for the roselike nation to appear before God at this beginning of the year. Her children tremble on this day while they stand before the awe-inspiring throne. They let their prayers be heard this day. They blow with a loud blast to find salvation. On her (Sarah) do they rely, to be considered for her sake, they cry out in assembly, knock at the gates, depend on the ashes of the sheep at the sacrifice of Isaac, the glorious gift with which she had been considered. He rises in judgment, rising together with the loud blast, to shake the earth and its inhabitants. But with the Shofar (the memory of the Shofar) I appease Him, and with bent knee, in the shelter of friends, will I sound in His garden (the Sanctuary) the shattering tone. Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God. O King, helper, saviour and shield. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, shield of Abraham. Thou art for ever mighty, O Lord, the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save. Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling, healing the sick and releasing the captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.

s128.primary: תַּאֲלַת זוֹ כְּחָפֵץ לְהוֹעִיל. שׁוּעַ עֲרוֹךְ לִמְּדָם לְהוֹעִיל. רוֹן הַרְרֵי קֶדֶם הַמּוֹעִיל. קְרוֹא בְגָרוֹן מוֹקֵשׁ לְהַגְעִיל: צִדְקָם לְהַקְפוֹת בְּנִיב שְׁוָעָה. פָּעֳלָם בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים לְשַׁמֵּעָה. עֵת רָצוֹן וְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָה. סְבִיכַת קֶרֶן וּכְרוֹת שְׁבוּעָה: נוֹבְבִים בְּגִישַׁת הַיוֹמַת תִּשְׁעָה. מִסְפַּר שְׁמוֹת וְחוֹתְמֵיהֶן הַתִּשְׁעָה. לְמִנְיַן פְּלִיל שֵׁמוֹת הַתִּשְׁעָה. כְּתַחֲנַת עֲקָרָה יַלְדָּה שִׁבְעָה: יַאֲמִירוּ עֹז מַלְכוּת עֶשֶׂר. טְבוּעוֹת לְשֵׁם בָּחוּן בָּעֶשֶׂר. חֹק זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְקוֹלוֹת עֶשֶׂר. זֵכֶר מְבֹרָךְ גְּבִיר בְּעֶשֶׂר: וַיֶּפֶן בָּאָהוּב אַחֲרוֹ נַהֲרִים. הֶעָקוּד בְּהַר מוֹר אַחֲרוּים. דִּשְׁנוֹ יַרְא לְחֵן שְׁחָרִים. גִּישַׁת עַנְיוֹ בֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם: בְּזֶה פֶּרֶק חוּג עֲתִירָה. בְּעַד אֲמוּרָה עַד הוּתָרָה. אֶנְקַת אָסִיר אָז כּוֹכְתָרָה. אֵלַי לְהֵעָתֵר כְּמוֹ נֶעְתָּרָה: מֶלֶךְ בְּדִין עָלוֹת בִּתְרוּעָה. גֵּא עִם דָּרֶיהָ לְרוֹעֲעָה. בְּשׁוֹפָר אֲפַתֶּנּוּ. וּבְבֶרֶךְ כְּרָעָה. בְּטַלְלֵי תְחִי בְּגַנּוֹ אֲתְרוֹעֲעָה:

s129.primary: When He wished to heal the folly of His people, He taught them to arrange prayer so that it should be of help, the valued prayer of the primaeval mountains, to call aloud in order to scare the accuser. He taught them to affirm their righteousness with an outburst of entreaty, to recall at a time of favour and on the day of salvation their toil over the years, the ram caught in the thicket, the covenant and the oath. They recite the prayer with nine benedictions, nine is the number of blessings and their endings, according to the names of God in that prayer which the childless one (Hannah) uttered, who later gave birth to seven children. They revere in ten verses the acknowledgment of divine rule, they are based on him who was ten times tested (Abraham), the measure of remembrance and of Shofar tones is ten in memory of him who with ten blessings made his son master. May He gaze upon the beloved son of him who was brought out of Mesopotamia, who was bound hand and foot on Mount Moriah, let Him behold his ashes so as to be gracious to his descendants, who approach Him morning and noon. On this day he (Isaac) fervently entreated on behalf of his childless wife, until she too was remembered. As the sighs of the childless one were answered then, so let my prayer too be heard as hers was heard. The King rises in judgment with the loud blast to shake the earth with its inhabitants, but with the Shofar (the memory of the Shofar) I appease Him, and with bent knee in the dew of revival will I sound in His garden the shattering tone.

s130.primary: מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים. זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים. וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים: אֶבֶן חוּג מָצוּק נְשִׁיָּה. תְּהוֹם רַבָּה עַל שִׁאִיָּה. בְּפִנַּת רֹאשׁ יְסוֹד שְׁלִישִׁיָּה. שָׁתֲתוּ שָׁעוּן בָּהּ לְשָׁשִׁיָּה: גִּנְפַּת שֵׁשׁ מְאוּמַת בָּנִים. רְבָעֶיהָ הַיוֹם מֵאַרְבָּעָה אֲבָנִים. דִּמּוּעַת מְבַכָּה עַל בָּנִים. קִשְּׁבָה מְנִיעִי אֵם הַבָּנִים: הָאַדְמוֹן כְּמַּט שֶׁלֹּא חָקַרָה. צָמָה לְקַחֲתָהּ לוֹ וְנִפְחָדָה. וּפִלְלָה רַבּוֹת בְּעַד הַתּוֹחֵלָה. פְּדוּתָהּ מִזֵּד וְלֹא חֻלָּלָה: זָכַר לָהּ יֹשֶׁר אֳרָחוֹת. עוּבָר לְהָמִיר בְּבֶטֶן אָחוֹת. חֻשְׁבָּה כַּהַיוֹם וְזָכְרָה לְהֵאָחוֹת. סוּקַף דִּינָה בְּיוֹסֵף לְהַנְחוֹת: טֶבַע בִּכְלִי יוֹצֵר הֶעֱבִיר. נִסֵּי חֲיָלִים לְהַנְעִים וּלְהַגְבִּיר. יָהּ כְּעֲתָרַת אֵיתָן גָּבִיר. מַטּוֹת שְׁנַיִם מִנָּה הִסְבִּיר: כַּעֲקֶרֶת בַּיִת כְּרָחֵל נָכְרִיָּה. כִּבְכוֹר רֵאשִׁית מִכֹּל נִפְרִיָּה. לְבָנֶיהָ תַעֲמוֹד בְּיוֹם זִכְרִיָּה. לְהִזָּכֵר כְּמוֹ נִזְכְּרָה: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ: וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵל נָא:

s131.primary: Who is like Thee, Father of compassion, who remembers His creatures for life in compassion. And Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who revives the dead. The fortress of heaven, the foundation of the earth, the roaring waves of the deep flood, found their firm foundation through the first born son of the third mother (of our people). She, the root of our people, who lacked children and was today surrounded by her sister’s four sons, shed tears for children; then she heard divine comfort as a mother of children. When the tawny one (Esau) saw that she did not bear children, he hoped to possess her, then was she terrified. Fervently she prayed that his hope would not be fulfilled, that she might be delivered from the arrogant man and not be defiled. The Lord remembered the integrity of her ways, transformed the child in her sister’s womb; she was remembered today, for God recalled her sisterly affection and granted Joseph instead of Dinah. He changed nature as with a potter’s tool, to show the wonders of His strength and might. The Lord noted the plea of the strong (Jacob) and let two tribes emerge from her. As the barren woman of the household she was regarded as a stranger, but in the end a first born stemmed from her. May she protect her children on the day of remembrance, that they may be remembered as she herself was remembered. The Lord will rule for eternity, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah. And Thou, Holy One, dwellest above the songs of praise of Israel, O God.

s132.primary: אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ: גִּבּוֹר וְנַעֲרָץ. דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה: הוּא שָׂח וַיֶּהִי. וְצִוָּה וְנִבְרָאוּ: זִכְרוֹ לָנֶצַח. חַי עוֹלָמִים: טְהוֹר עֵינַיִם. יוֹשֵׁב סֵתֶר: כִּתְרוֹ יְשׁוּעָה. לְבוּשׁוֹ צְדָקָה: מַעֲטֵהוּ קִנְאָה. נֶאְפָּד נְקָמָה: סִתְרוֹ יֹשֶׁר. עֲצָתוֹ אֱמוּנָה: פְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֱמֶת. צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר: קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. רָם וּמִתְנַשֵּׂא: שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים. תּוֹלֶה אֶרֶץ עַל בְּלִימָה: חַי וְקַיָּם נוֹרָא בַמָּרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ: תָּעִיר וְתָרִיעַ. לְהַכְרִית כָּל־מֵרֵעַ. וְתִקָּדֵשׁ בְּיוֹדְעֵי לְהָרִיעַ. קָדוֹשׁ: אַדֶּרֶת מַמְלָכָה. עַד מָה הֻשְׁלָכָה. וְעוֹד לֹא מָלְכָה: לְבֵל הִמְלִיכָה. וְאַחֲרָיו הָלְכָה. שֶׁלֹּא כַהֲלָכָה: עָלֶיהָ הַמְלָכָה. גְּבֶרֶת מַמְלָכָה. עַד תּוֹפִיעַ מְלוּכָה: וַכְלִילֵי שְׁמוֹ מְפָאֲרִים עֲדַת חֶבְלוֹ. וְנַעֲרִיץ בְּאֶרְאֶלֵּי קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלוֹ. וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כָּבוֹד אָמַר כּוּלּוֹ. קָדוֹשׁ: שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְווֹתָיו עוֹד יְשׁוּבוּן לְבִצָּרוֹן. נִדְבָּרִים יְרֵאָיו בְּטֹהַר וְיִתְרוֹן. וַיַּקְשֵׁב יְיָ וַיִּשְׁמַע וַיִּכָּתֵב בְּסֵפֶר זִכָּרוֹן. קָדוֹשׁ: שַׁפְּרוּ מַעֲשִׂים וּבְרִית לֹא תוּפָר. נַאֲקַתְכֶם יַאֲזִין שְׁחָקִים שִׁפַּר. וְתִיטַב לַיְיָ מִשּׁוֹר פָּר. קָדוֹשׁ:

s133.primary: Thou art our God in heaven and on earth. Mighty and awe-inspiring distinguished among myriads. He spoke and it came to pass, He commanded, then were they created. His memory is forever, He lives in all eternity. Pure is His gaze, He is enthroned in mystery. His crown is salvation, His robe is righteousness. His cloak is zeal, He is girded with retribution. His mystery is equity, His counsel faith. His work is truth, He is just and upright. He is close to those who call Him in truth, lofty and exalted. He resides in the clouds and suspends the earth in space. Living, enduring, awe-inspiring, lofty and holy. Thou dost rise and let the trumpet sound to destroy every evil doer, and Thou art sanctified by those who know how to sound the Teruah, Holy One. The glorious realm, how has it been cast down and not yet been restored to rule. It swore allegiance to Bel, it followed him against the law. Thus there gained dominion over it a mighty alien realm, until God’s realm will once again appear. It has burned my sanctuary, it has crushed my upright His Name is praised by the community of His portion, His praise is proclaimed by the holy Erelim and in His sanctuary everything utters glory of the Holy One. Those who observe His commandments will yet return to the fortress, those who fear Him, speak to one another in purity and bliss, and the Lord has listened and heard and it is inscribed in the book of remembrance, the Holy One. Improve your deeds that the covenant may not be broken, He who has adorned the skies will hear your cry, and it will be more pleasing than the sacrifice of oxen to the Lord the Holy One.

s134.primary: חָרְכָה. מִתְמִימַי פָּרְכָה. וְנִתַּן לָהּ אַרְכָּה: רָחֲבָה וְאָרְכָה. וְקַשְׁתָּהּ דָּרְכָה. וְעֹל הֶאֱרִיכָה: בְּעַתַּתָּהּ בְּרַכָּה. וְהִנֵּה דְרוּכָה. וְעַד עַתָּה מוֹלְכָה: יְסוֹדוֹת עִרְמָה. עֵרָה וְהֶחֱרִימָה. וְעַד יְסוֹד עֵירֹמָה: רֹאשׁ הֵרִימָה. וְסוֹד הֶעֱרִימָה. וַתְּהִי רָמָה: בְּעָרְמָה מַעֲרִימָה. וְעַד שַׁחַק רָמָה. וְתָאֱפוֹד מְלוּכָה: יְרִיעוֹתַי גָּרְדָה. אָהֳלֵי שָׁדְדָה. וְחָרְשָׁה וְשִׂדְּדָה: קַנְיָנוּת רָפְדָה. וּמַלְכוּת אָפְדָה. וְאֶת הִקְפִּידָה: יוֹזְמֵי וּפִרְדָּה. עֲבוֹד שִׁבְטֵי מְקוֹרָאֶךָ עֲלֵה וּמְשׁוֹל. נְטִישׁוֹת צָרִים כְּהִתְוִיז לְנַשֵּׁל. כִּי לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה וּמוֹשֵׁל. קָדוֹשׁ: שְׁבוּתֵנוּ מִמֶּרְחָק עֲלוֹת לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ. וּנְפָאֲרֶנּוּ תָּמִיד בִּדְבִיר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ. כִּי זָכַר אֶת דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ. קָדוֹשׁ: אֲדָר וָהוֹד אֶתֵּן בְּצִבְיוֹן. שׁוּעַ אֶעֶרְכָה בְּנִיב וְהִגָּיוֹן. אֶקְרָא לֵאלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן: בְּיוֹם הַנִּבְחָר מִשְּׁמֵי עָרִיץ. מֵישָׁרִים לִשְׁפֹּט קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ לְהַעֲרִיץ. יְיָ מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ: גֵּאוּתוֹ גָּדְלָה עוֹלָם מֵהָכִיל. עֱזוּזוֹ לְסַפֵּר כֹּחַ מִי יָכִיל. מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל: שְׁמוֹ מְפָאֲרִים. דַּע יִשְׁמוּ כָּל בְּרִיוֹתָיו. וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי גָדְלוּ גְּבוּרוֹתָיו. זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו: הִצִּיב וְיָדָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתוֹ. נַחֲלִיאֵל עֲבוּר לְשַׁעֲשֵׁעַ בְּאֻמָּתוֹ. יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:

s135.primary: men and has achieved length of rule. It has expanded greatly, stretched the bow and extended far its yoke. It has frightened the tender people (Israel) and trampled it down, and rules to this day. It has loosened and destroyed the foundation stones of the Temple and laid them bare down to the ground. It has lifted up its head, devised a secret plan and stands there powerfully. It is ablaze with guile, raises itself up to heaven and girds itself in majesty. My tapestries has it torn, destroyed my tabernacles, ploughed and harrowed its site. It has acquired dominion, wrapped itself in might and offended this people (Israel). It initiated rebellion, served idols zealously Let the tribes of those Thou hast called, arise and rule, cut off the branches of enemies and let them fall, for both kingdom and ruler belong to the Lord, the Holy One. May our exiled ascend from afar His holy mountain that we may praise Him always in His Inner Sanctuary, for He has remembered His holy word, the Holy One. All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth do constantly say: Great things has the Lord performed on earth, and the Lord shall be King over all the earth, the Holy One. Glorification and praise willingly do I bestow, I order prayer in speech and thought, I call upon the supreme God. On the day chosen from the mighty heavens for upright judgment, to glorify His holiness, the Lord rules, the earth rejoices. The world is too small to contain His loftiness, who is there able to describe His might? King of all the earth is God, then sing with understanding. May all His creatures acquire perception and know how great is His might. A memorial has He established for His wonders. He has firmly planted His foundation stone (Torah), the divine gift, so as to rejoice in His people. He remembers His covenant for ever.

s136.primary: לְזוּ חָרְדָה. וְחִלְּלָה מְלוּכָה: לְהָצוֹת בְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ. וּפָצָה לְעֵין מֶלֶךְ. מִי לִי בָרָק מֶלֶךְ: יָהֲרָה בְּכֵס מֶלֶךְ. זוּלָתִי אֵין מֶלֶךְ. אֲנִי וְאַפְסִי מֶלֶךְ: רָם עַל כָּל־מֶלֶךְ. תַּעֲבִירֶנָּה מִמֶּלֶךְ. וּלְךָ תָּשִׁיב מְלוּכָה: תָּעִיר וְתָרִיעַ. לְהַכְרִית כָּל מֵרֵעַ. וְתִקָּדֵשׁ בְּיוֹדְעֵי לְהָרִיעַ. קָדוֹשׁ: מֶלֶךְ מְמַלֵּט מֵרָעָה. לְיוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ: מֶלֶךְ זוֹכֵר אֲחוּז קֶרֶן. לְתוֹקְעֵי לְךָ הַיּוֹם בְּקֶרֶן. נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ: וְרָשַׁם בְּחֹק דַּת הֶגְיוֹנִי. בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה לִפְקוֹד זִכְרוֹנִי. לְזִכָּרוֹן בְּהֵיכַל יְיָ שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְווֹתָיו. זֶבַח קֹדֶשׁ כְּהֻכְשַׁר אָז בְּעֵינָיו. רֶגֶל תְּמוּרָתוֹ אַיִל לְהַקְרִיב לְפָנָיו. אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּבַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו: חִנֵּם חֲנִיטָיו לִתְקוֹעַ בְּזֶה חֹדֶשׁ. יוֹם זֶה אִם יִקְרֶה בְּשַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ. זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ: טִבְעוֹן אִם בְּחֹל יְבֹאָכֶם. צַוּוּ לִתְקוֹעַ בְּכָל גְּבוּלְכֶם. יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם: שַׁפְּרוּ. יָרוּם צוּר יִשְׁעִי פִּי כָל־אֻמִּים. חֲשׂוֹף זְרוֹעֲךָ לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים. מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עוֹלָמִים: כְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ לְעֵין כֹּל שְׁכִינָה לְהוֹעֵד. קְהִלּוֹת וְרִבְבוֹת בְּנִימוֹ לְהָעֵד. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד: לְךָ יָאֲתָה כָּבוֹד וְעֹז הַגּוֹיִם. חֶלֶד וְכָל שׁוֹכְנֶיהָ וְכָל הָאִיִּים. מִי לֹא יִרָאֲךָ מֶלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם: שִׁבְטֵי.

s137.primary: and desecrated the realm of God. It oppressed the King’s children (Israel) and said in the sight of the King: “Who is in heaven my king?”. There is boasting from the royal throne: “There is no king besides me, I alone am king”. O Thou who art exalted above all kings, remove from it the rank of king, so that the kingdom may return to Thee. Thou dost rise and let the trumpet sound to destroy every evil doer, and Thou art sanctified by those who know how to sound the Teruah, Holy One. O King, Thou savest from misfortune those who understand Teruah, Holy God. O King, Thou dost remember him (Isaac) who was caught by the horn (the ram) on behalf of those who blow the horn before Thee today, O awe-inspiring and Holy One! He has inscribed my thoughts through a statute of the faith so as to remember me year by year, for a remembrance in the sanctuary of the Lord. When the holy sacrifice (Isaac) once found favour in His eyes, He allowed a ram to be sacrificed in his stead, which was later caught with his horns in the thicket. He taught the descendants of (Isaac) to blow the Shofar on this new moon; but if this day falls on a Sabbath, then the mere mention of Teruah is a sacred proclamation. When it falls on a weekday for you, let it be blown in all your regions, let it be a day of Teruah for you. Exalted is the rock of my salvation in the mouths of all peoples. Expose Thine arm to help us against adversaries, Thy realm is a realm of all eternity. When Thou revealest Thyself before all eyes to visit once again Thy dwelling place, congregations in their myriads will proclaim aloud: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever. Becoming to Thee is honour and the acknowledgment of might pronounced by the earth and its inhabitants and all the isles: who does not fear Thee, King of the nations.

s138.primary: אוֹפִיר נַז אָיוֹם. בְּשִׁלּוּשׁ קְדֻשַּׁת הַיוֹם: גִּבּוֹרֵי כֹחַ גְּדֻלָּה. דִּדּוּהוּ בְבֵית דִּיגְלָה: חוּג הוֹגֶה הֶמְלָה. וּתְקוֹעֵהוּ בְּהִלּוּל וּמִלָּה: זוֹכֵר לָעַד זָכִיּוֹת. חֲדִישׁוּהוּ זֶמֶר חַיּוֹת: טוֹב עוֹמֵס טָרַח. יְיַחֲדוּהוּ בְּחִדּוּשׁ יֶרַח: כּוֹבֵשׁ כָּל־כְּעָסִים. לְבַל אַף לְהָשִׂים: מְשָׁרְתָיו בְּחִיל מוֹרָא. נִכְחָם הַלְלוּ נוֹרָא: שַׂרְפֵי סְבִיב סַעֲרָה. עֱנוּ לְמַעֲבִיר מוֹטַת צָרִים שְׁבֹר וְהַכְחִידֵם. וּדְחוּיֶיךָ קַבֵּץ וְחִנָּם תִּפְדֵּם. זְכוֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶדֶם: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נַחֲמוּ בְּכִפְלַיִם. קָמֵיהֶם עַל פָּנֵימוֹ גַּלֵּה שׁוּלַיִם. זְכֹר יְיָ לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָיִם: סְלִיל מְסִלָּתֵנוּ יַשֵּׁר לְצַעַד. וּבֵין יְקִירָה קַרְסֹל לֹא יִמְעַד. כִּנְאֻמַת זָכוֹר אֶזְכְּרֶנּוּ עוֹד: שְׁבוּתֵנוּ. קִרְיַת מְשׂוֹשׂ הֵיכָל וְאוּלָם. מִזְבֵּחַ יָשִׁיב וּכְלֵי שָׁרֵת כֻּלָּם. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם: שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יְרַנְּנוּ לִשְׁמוֹ. יְעָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כַף לְהַנְעִימוֹ. כִּי פָקַד יְיָ אֶת עַמּוֹ: תֹּקֶף אֶרְאֶלִּים וְכוֹכְבֵי צָפֶר. תְּהִלּוֹת יִתְּנוּ שֶׁבַח לְהַשְׁפִּיר. הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר: (כל יושבי תבל ושוכני ארץ. ואמרו תמיד הגדיל יְיָ לעשות בארץ. והיה יְיָ למלך על כל הארץ. קדוש:) יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וּלְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ: וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ. וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּעַשׂ. נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ:

s139.primary: I adorn the awe-inspiring with a crown through the threefold sanctification of the day. The strong in might and greatness rejoice before Him in the house of assembly. They who praise in tumultuous throngs, laud Him with glorifying word. To Him who remembers piety for ever, do the Hayoth sing a new song. Praise Him alone — benevolent is He and forgives sins — on the day of the new moon. He suppresses wrath entirely and does not allow anger. O you (the angels) who serve Him in trembling and fear, praise Him who is awe-inspiring in the presence of those (Israel). Angels of fire encircled by the whirlwind, chant in honour of Him who Break the yoke of adversaries, destroy them; gather those dispersed by Thee and redeem them without ransom. Remember Thy congregation which Thou hast once chosen. Comfort the noblest of peoples, expose to their faces the shame of those who rise against them; remember, O Lord, against the sons of Edom the day of Jerusalem. Make even our highway, straighten it for our steps that the foot of Thy favourite may not stumble, as Thou hast said: I will surely still remember him. The joyful city, sanctum and porch, and the altar may He restore with all the sacred vessels; the Lord will reign for ever. Heaven and earth exult at His Name; forests clap their hands in delight in Him; for the Lord has considered His people. The mighty Erelim and the bright stars in glory will proclaim His praise. Praise Him with the Shofar blast. (All the inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth do constantly say: Great things has the Lord performed on earth, and the Lord shall be King over all the earth, the Holy One.) He judges the world in justice and nations in righteousness. God is holy. He is unique, who can reply to Him? Whatever His soul desires, He accomplishes, Awe-inspiring and Holy!

s140.primary: עֶבְרָה: פְּלִיאָים פִּצְחוּ פֶה. צִלְצְלוּ הַכֹּל צוֹפֶה: קְהִלּוֹת עַם קְדוֹשִׁים. רוֹמְמוּהוּ רְבָבוֹת רוֹעֲשִׁים: שְׁמֹעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר. תַּאֲזִין וְאַשְׁמָה תוּפָר: תְּשַׁלֵּשׁ שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּהַר הַקֹּדֶשׁ. וַאֲשַׁלֵּשׁ קְדֻשָּׁה בַּקֹּדֶשׁ: מֶלֶךְ זוֹכֵר אֲחוּז קֶרֶן. לְתוֹקְעֵי לְךָ הַיּוֹם בְּקֶרֶן. נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ: אֶתֵּן לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. בְּיוֹם הֻנְבָּחַר מַעַשׂ לְהַבְדֵּק: גֵּאוּתוֹ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה. דֶּרֶךְ עַנְוְתוֹ לְפִי הַגְּדֻלָּה: הוּא אָדוֹן הָעוֹלָם. וּמִי הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם: זוֹכֵר הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֹם. חוֹנֵן וְעוֹשֶׂה דִין יָתוֹם: טָהוֹר מָרוֹם וְנִשָּׂא. יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ הַכֹּל עָשָׂה: כַּבִּיר לֹא יִמְאַס לְנִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס: מְפֹאָר רוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת. נֹגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת: סוֹעֵף בְּחַרְבוֹת שְׁנוּנוֹת. עֲבוּר יְתוֹמִים וְאַלְמָנוֹת: פֹּעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֵּם. צוּר פֶּה וּמֵשִׂים אִלֵּם: קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל בְּרַחֲמִים. רָם וּמַשְׁפִּיל רָמִים: שׁוֹפֵט יְצוּרָיו בַּחֲנִינָה. תָּמִים פֹּעַל אֵל אֱמוּנָה: שׁוֹפְטֵי אֶרֶץ תֹּהוּ. פַּחֲדוֹ יִבָּהֲלוּ וְיִתְמָהוּ: עוֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ. וּתְחִלָּה מַקְדִּימָם מִפְּנֵי זַעְמוֹ: נְדִיבִים בְּדִקְדוּקָם יָחִילוּ. כַּאֲשֶׁר מִשְׁפָּטוֹ פָעָלוּ: רוֹאֶה כָל־תַעֲלוּמוֹת. יוֹשֵׁב בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמוֹת: צוֹפֶה כָל נוֹלְדוֹת. חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל הָעֲתִידוֹת: קוֹרֵא הַדּוֹרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ. חִקְרֵי לֵב לָתוּר וְלִדְרוֹשׁ: זוֹכֵר בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים. קַיֵּם שְׁבוּעָה לְאַחֲרוֹנִים: יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק. וּלְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ:

s141.primary: removes wrath. Angels of mystery, open your mouths to praise Him who sees all. Congregations of the holy people, praise Him, tumultuous myriads. Hearken to the loud blast of the Shofar that guilt may be forgiven. Three times wilt Thou sound the Shofar blast on the holy mountain; three times will I pronounce the sanctification in the Sanctuary. O King, Thou dost remember him (Isaac) who was caught by the horn (the ram) on behalf of those who blow the horn before Thee today, O Awe-inspiring and Holy One. I praise the justice of my Creator on the day appointed for the examination of deeds. His majesty is great, but the way of His humility accords with His greatness. He is Lord of the world, who can resist Him and remain unharmed? He remembers the man who walks in uprightness, and graciously promotes the cause of the orphan. Pure, lofty and exalted, He has made everything harmonious in its time. Although Almighty, He does not reject the man who in his own eyes is despised and rejected. Glorified, riding above the clouds, radiance is in front of Him and blazing fire. He rages with sharp swords on behalf of orphans and widows. He requites man according to his work. He shapes the mouth and also makes it dumb. Owner of all in compassion, He is lofty and lowers the lofty. He judges His creatures with clemency, perfect in action, God of faithfulness. Earthly judges are as nought, they are frightened through dread of Him and perplexed. He executes the judgment of His people, warning them first of His wrath. Noble ones tremble at the thought of their judgment, as to whether they have accomplished His law. He sees all that are hidden, He dwells in the loftiest heights, He perceives all that is happening, He explores all that is about to come. He summons the generations from the very beginning in order to search out and discover the thoughts of their hearts. O Thou who dost remember the covenant with those who came first, fulfil the promise to those who come last. He judges the world in justice and nations in righteousness. God is holy.

The strong and lofty raise their voice aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, The Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever. The fiery in their haste utter aloud: The Lord is King. The massed multitude praise aloud: The Lord has reigned. And the hosts and the Hayoth testify aloud: The Lord will reign. Princes in heaven glorify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, The Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever. Heirs of the precious teaching affirm aloud: The Lord is King. The mighty in strength pay homage aloud: The Lord has reigned. Those enveloped in flames give thanks aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, The Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever. They who speak pleasing words say aloud: The Lord is King. They who sparkle with brilliance triumph aloud: The Lord has reigned.
